finding.name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
finding.summary: saveNote() writes a new file, so realpath() on the not-yet-existing destination returns false on essentially every legitimate call, not just malicious ones; the ?: fallback then substitutes the original unresolved path (still containing any '../' segments) into a containment check that passes by construction - it always starts with $baseDir - so file_put_contents writes to whatever that unresolved path names, including outside $baseDir
